name: Jorel's Brother
description: This Brazilian TV show tells the story of young Jorel's Brother daily life, including dealing with his family, school and friends.

credits_cast.character: Irmão do Jorel / Beto Cachinhos / Rambozo (voice)
credits_cast.name: Andrei Duarte

credits_cast.character: Nico / Tosh / Steve Magal / Roberto Perdigoto / Gesonel/ Jorginho (voice)
credits_cast.name: Hugo Picchi Neto

credits_cast.character: Seu Edson / Diretora Lola / Wonderlay / Seu Adelino (voice)
credits_cast.name: César Marchetti

credits_cast.character: Vovó Juju / Lara / Ana Catarina / Catiane (voice)
credits_cast.name: Melissa Garcia

videos.title: Perdigotto Show: Flared Briefs
videos.overview: Perdigoto invites Carlos Felino's band, "Os Cuecas em Chamas", to do a live interview on his show.

videos.title: Perdigotto Show: Jorel's brother
videos.overview: Perdigoto asks Jorel's brother questions.

videos.title: Perdigotto Show: Edson and Danuza
videos.overview: Perdigoto receives the presence of Brother do Jorel's parents

videos.title: Perdigotto Show: Jorelovers Vs Joreletes
videos.overview: When Grandma Juju keeps saying things that come to her mind that have nothing to do with the program, Perdigoto cancels it and makes jokes only with Grandma Juju.

videos.title: Perdigotto Show: Steve Magal
videos.overview: Perdigoto asks Steve Magal questions.

videos.title: Perdigotto Show: Executives
videos.overview: Perdigoto invites Shostners & Shostners executives for an exclusive interview.

videos.title: Belezitos: The Musical
videos.overview: The beauties sing a song about Jorel.

videos.title: Yuki Show I
videos.overview: Lara's adventures with the talking cat Yuki become a new Shostners & Shostners reality show.

videos.title: Yuki Show II
videos.overview: Yuki reveals to Lara that he has some hidden emotions.

videos.title: Yuki Show III
videos.overview: During a conversation with Lara, Yuki talks about his main topic of wanting to form a new music band.

videos.title: Yuki Show IV
videos.overview: During a rock, paper, and scissors play between Lara and Yuki, Shostners & Shostners executives negotiate over a new batch of Yuki products, and some additional content from Lara.

videos.title: The Lara & Yuki Show
videos.overview: Lara and Yuki meet a pair of Japanese people who decide to train them in the great art of gigijutsu.

videos.title: The Lara & Yuki Show 2
videos.overview: Who doesn't want to have a pet like Yuki?

videos.title: Brutal Carnival Special
videos.overview: The family of Irmão do Jorel almost gives up on Carnival when a soft drink brand sponsors a party, standardizing all costumes and always playing the same march. Everything changes when Granny Juju gets lost in the crowd and now everyone will have to dive into the biggest popular party on the planet to keep the family together.

videos.title: Jorel's Brother Christmas Special: Santa's Brother
videos.overview: Jorel's family prepares for Christmas Eve with a big dinner, flashing lights, plates, cutlery and cups, only used on very special occasions. The china cabinet is finally opened.

videos.title: The Phenomenal Helmet with Casters
videos.overview: Jorel's brother tries to prove to his parents that he can ride a bicycle without training wheels, as long as he wears training wheels on his helmet.

videos.title: Seesaws of the Revolution
videos.overview: After hearing a story from his father about the revolution, Jorel's Brother has to spend a day at school without ruining his Steve Magal Special Series Camouflage Short.

videos.title: Fight Club
videos.overview: Jorel's brother goes to Seu Adelino's store to buy a Sprok Apple from Grandma Gigi and ends up involved in a clandestine wrestling club led by Billy Doidão.

videos.title: Do Not Be Afraid of Your Fear
videos.overview: Jorel's brother wakes up from a nightmare with the strange feeling of being watched by ducks.

videos.title: Backyard's Newspaper
videos.overview: Jorel's brother records a newspaper in the backyard of grandmother Juju invading the family's privacy with the precious VHS camera “Obsoleta 500” by Seu Edson.

videos.title: The Mystery of the Ultra-Secret Little Notes
videos.overview: Jorel's brother is obsessed with discovering what is written in the note that his passion, Ana Catarina, exchanges with his friends.

videos.title: The Dangerous Brutal Lambada
videos.overview: Jorel's brother participates in Dona Danuza's dance class to learn the Steve Magal's Lambada Brutal, but ends up being embarrassed in front of the entire school.

videos.title: The Story Without Beginning, Half and End
videos.overview: Jorel's brother runs away from home riding on Tosh in search of the meaning of life after his family can't find any pictures of him when he was a baby.

videos.title: Maximum Expressiveness
videos.overview: Steve Magal launches contest to find a child actor for his new film, and Irmão do Jorel trains with Seu Edson developing his expressiveness in the search for the role.

videos.title: The Terrible Attack of the Mutants Lice
videos.overview: Jorel's brother returns home with lice and contaminates the whole family that needs to race against time so that the epidemic does not spread further.

videos.title: Nature Totally Wild
videos.overview: The family hires a pest control and tourism service to rid the house of insects and visit a water park, where Irmão do Jorel meets Mendigo dos Mares.

videos.title: Matutinal Journey Ruthless
videos.overview: Jorel's brother needs to race against time to arrive early on the first day of school with his favorite jacket and get a place next to his passion, Ana Catarina.

videos.title: Terrifying Adulthood
videos.overview: Billy Doidão blows the birthday candle of the Brother of Jorel, who becomes an adult along with Lara and Marcinho. They go on a chase to retrieve a stolen car.

videos.title: Pen of 250 Colors
videos.overview: Jorel's brother needs to find the 250-color pen, the most desired object in the class, and lend it to Ana Catarina before the unscrupulous William Shostners.

videos.title: Boarding in This Wave
videos.overview: Jorel's brother can't stay up late to watch the smash hit cartoon “Microwave Warriors” and is completely out of the loop at school.

videos.title: Profession: Clown
videos.overview: Jorel's brother is asked to be recruited at Professor Rambozo's clown apprentice school and discovers that making others laugh is a serious profession.

videos.title: An Odissey in the Recreational Space
videos.overview: Jorel's brother is grounded in the room without any toys and needs to use his imagination to escape the absolute boredom next to Tosh.

videos.title: Hunters for the Lost Cards
videos.overview: Grandma Gigi decides to help Irmão do Jorel complete the Steve Magal sticker album by taking him into the underworld of Seu Adelino's basement players.

videos.title: Mortal Scavenger Hunt
videos.overview: Jorel's brother and Jorel join in a sibling contest to defeat the cheaters Shostners and the hitherto unknown Brother of Shostners.

videos.title: Crazy Island
videos.overview: The family wins a trip around the world and ends up discovering a fascinating country ruled by a needy eccentric man who needs a new little brother.

videos.title: The Incredible Lateenagers
videos.overview: Seu Edson becomes a businessman for Cuecas em Chamas and to participate in a band competition, he places Jorel as leader and Irmão do Jorel as a towel rack.

videos.title: The Legend of The Cotton Woman
videos.overview: Jorel's brother arrives at school crazy to pee and desperately enters a restrained bathroom because of the rumor of a cruel creature called "cotton woman".

videos.title: Family Afloat
videos.overview: Seu Edson takes a long time to take a selfie with Irmão do Jorel on top of a buoy, and they end up lost at sea while the rest of the family enjoys the summer at the beach.

videos.title: Little Master of Gi Gitsu
videos.overview: When Jorel's brother comes home with a black eye, Grandma Gigi promises to turn him into a great fighter of an ancient martial art invented by her, Gi Gitsu.

videos.title: Rage and Power On Wheels
videos.overview: Jorel's brother and Lara pass under a giant rainbow and discover the fury and power of a sport practiced only by girls, roller derby.

videos.title: My Second Love
videos.overview: It's a June party and everyone is with their peers, except Irmão do Jorel, who wants to ask Ana Catarina to marry him.

videos.title: Carlos Felino: Matchmaker
videos.overview: Carlos Felino helps Irmão do Jorel to overcome his insecurities in the face of his love for Ana Catarina by giving advice that is not advisable on the day of the friendship post.

videos.title: Fluffy, the Killer Dolphin
videos.overview: Jorel's brother embarks on a journalistic adventure with Seu Edson to investigate the whereabouts of a dangerous and treacherous creature that fled the city's aquarium.

videos.title: Shostners Shopping
videos.overview: Jorel's brother gets lost from Grandma Juju at the pharaonic Shostners Shopping and the two need to overcome their most uncontrollable fears to find themselves.

videos.title: Consequence or Consequence?
videos.overview: It's Ana Catarina's birthday, and Irmão do Jorel intends to declare her love. She pity that no one understands what he says because of the new dental appliance.

videos.title: Through the Wardrobe
videos.overview: Gesonel creates a Jorel Brother doll to go to school in his place and hides the real one in the closet. Right on the day that Steve Magal is going to take pictures at the school.

videos.title: Awesome Tour Without Brake
videos.overview: Jorel's brother is late for the excursion to Steve Magal's camp, and Dona Danuza tries everything to get him on the bus. But Wonderlay tries everything to stop him.

videos.title: Jorel's Brother and the Soda Factory
videos.overview: The gang meets an abandoned factory, which is actually where the Sprok Apple soda is made. Mr Sprok shows an enchanted world and leaves Lara suspicious.

videos.title: Brutal Camp
videos.overview: Jorel's brother and his gang arrive at Steve Magal's long-awaited camp to learn all about how to survive in the jungle while surviving in the jungle.

videos.title: So it's Christmas
videos.overview: At Christmas, Seu Edson and Dona Danuza try to keep the family together with more love and less material goods. Until a missing uncle showed up with gifts and strange conversations.

videos.title: The Secret Life of Belezitos
videos.overview: Jorel's brother believes that Grandma Juju knows how to rap and wants the world to witness this wonderful event. Does Grandma Juju want the same?

videos.title: MC Juju
videos.overview: Jorel's brother tries to prove to his whole family that Grandma Juju can sing rap and puts her on the show "Family Therapy", in which she enters a battle against rapper Kássius Kleyton, the Emicida.

videos.title: Saturday Afternoon Snacks
videos.overview: Jorel's brother thinks Nico is being controlled by aliens and he tries to solve this weird case.

videos.title: Interplanetary Success
videos.overview: Mr Edson discovers another destination for his cinematographic works: the internet. While Lara and Jorel's Brother try to help him, Jorel's Brother is kidnapped by an alien ship, which takes him to a planet where he becomes very famous for the success of the video "Granny's Astronaut".

videos.title: Maquinito, the Friend Robot
videos.overview: Jorel's brother tries to stop Maquinito, a psychopathic robot, with the help of Steve Magal from an alternative future.

videos.title: Silky Cream Double Cream
videos.overview: Jorel's brother uses a lot of cream to make his hair stronger and ends up causing it to come alive and cause damage all over town.

videos.title: Burger Shostners
videos.overview: After running away from a tenebrous healthy meal prepared by Danuza, Seu Edson must face the consequences of having taken Jorel's Brother to eat at the Shostners Burguer cafeteria.

videos.title: Nico's Brother
videos.overview: Nico is discovered by an agency that specializes in cute models only from the back after breaking up with the Blazing Underwear band. Meanwhile, Lara and Irmão do Jorel form a new band with Carlos Felino.

videos.title: Lost in Cinema
videos.overview: When his family arrives at the cinema, Jorel's Brother is barred from watching a new Steve Magal movie because it's inappropriate for his age, so his only option is to watch a little kids' movie, but Jorel's Brother runs away and gets inside a hiding under the movie theater, making him stop in the sewer where he meets a mysterious man, who is actually his grandfather, Seu Edson's father and Grandma Juju's ex-husband.

videos.title: Adelino Adventure Park
videos.overview: After Jorel's Brother watches a commercial for Clack Boom gum, he is distressed and goes to Seu Adelino's store to buy the gum, but when he enters the store, he discovers a secret extreme park found inside Seu Adelino's establishment.

videos.title: Back to the Future of the Past
videos.overview: Jorel's brother travels through time and tries to find out what happened to his favorite Steve Magal doll, but as his father said, time traveling can have several consequences.

videos.title: Brutal Recreation
videos.overview: Jorel's brother creates a great Steve Magal adventure at recess with his friends from school.

videos.title: Imaginary Enemy
videos.overview: When Jorel's Brother sits at the back of his school classroom, he starts thinking of an imaginary boy who just set bad examples for him.

videos.title: In Search of Freedom
videos.overview: Jorel's brother travels by car along the road with his grandparents while they are being chased by the police and this can be quite dangerous.

videos.title: Porcelain Elephant
videos.overview: During the school teamwork that Professor Adelaide requested for the holiday, Lara makes a big revelation that shocks Jorel's Brother.

videos.title: Sleeping Awake Sleeping
videos.overview: As he tries to watch the exact moment when night turns to day, Jorel's Brother no longer knows whether he's awake sleeping or sleeping awake.

videos.title: Eject Special
videos.overview: To take away his sadness, Brother Jorel wants to record the last episode of his favorite series "Microwave Warriors", but to take a tape that was in the VCR of Grandma Gigi's DVD player, you have to press the "Eject" button, but when the button doesn't work, Jorel's brother presses the Eject Especial button and everything that was recorded on the tape ends up being transported to reality.

videos.title: Badass Garden
videos.overview: Jorel's brother tries to end a rivalry between fruits and vegetables through a rap battle with the tomato (Special appearance by Criolo).

videos.title: Jorel's Little Brother
videos.overview: Jorel's brother remembers the first day he met Lara.

videos.title: The Househusband
videos.overview: Jorel's brother is in charge of the house for a single day, and accidentally breaks Grandma Gigi's television.

videos.title: Ed Show
videos.overview: Jorel's brother helps his father in the production of his new reality show.

videos.title: The Ideal Kite
videos.overview: Jorel's brother flies his first kite during a day at the beach.

videos.title: Contest of the Craziest of School
videos.overview: Back to school, Irmão do Jorel and Billy Doidão compete for the title of The Craziest of School.

videos.title: Grandma Takes Me to Class
videos.overview: Jorel's brother gets lost from Grandma Juju during a bus ride to school and he needs to find her again.

videos.title: Eternal Hiccup
videos.overview: Jorel's brother tries to get rid of his hiccups and he can only achieve this with the help of an oracle.

videos.title: Be Broccoli!
videos.overview: Jorel's brother is completely confused after he gets the role of "broccoli" in his school play, forcing Seu Edson to inspire him to behave like a vegetable.

videos.title: Shostners Cable
videos.overview: Jorel's brother uses Grandma Gigi's remote control to watch all the TV channels at the same time until he reaches infinity.

videos.title: Meanwhile, in Japan
videos.overview: In this episode focused on Lara, she befriends a talking cat named Yuki in the Japanese town and she resolves to help him find his family again.

videos.title: Cine Horror
videos.overview: Jorel's brother watches a horror movie during his visit to the William Shostners house.

videos.title: Zazazilla
videos.overview: After Jorel's Brother lets his writing job get eaten by Grandma Gigi's mascot, Zaza, he buys a pill that ends up making it grow. Jorel's brother takes the opportunity and enters Zaza's body to retrieve his work, but to his surprise, he finds Lara accompanied by the talking cat Yuki.

videos.title: Urgent Yard News
videos.overview: Irmão do Jorel makes a new journalistic report with the help of his colleagues to show the hallucinating events and happenings in the world.

videos.title: Life is Too Short to Like Soccer
videos.overview: Jorel's brother learns to play soccer while dancing.

videos.title: Carnival Anytime
videos.overview: After the commemorative dates of several countries end up coinciding because of the Earth's changing geography, it's up to Jorel's Brother and his friends to stop the exploitation of consumption by Shostners and Shostners.

videos.title: Steve vs Sidney
videos.overview: During a visit to the set of Steve Magal's new film, Brother Jorel discovers that it was all a big lie.

videos.title: My Friend Vincent
videos.overview: Jorel's brother has low grades in art education and Mr. Edson helps him by giving private lessons with the largest encyclopedia in the world. Jorel's brother embarks on a surreal adventure within the book and meets Vicente Van Gogh, the greatest painter and worst salesman of all time. Jorel's brother is willing to help his new friend find the stolen ear by traveling through various periods of history within the encyclopedia until he finds a very talented suspect: Beethoven.

videos.title: Revolution of Things
videos.overview: Household appliances cause the biggest revolt inside Irmão do Jorel's house.

videos.title: The Flying Sandals Clan
videos.overview: Grandma Gigi is the leader of a clan of mysterious old ladies who meet to play cards. At this meeting, one of the members realizes that Gigi's porcelain elephant, responsible for the harmony of the world, is damaged. The elders question Gigi's ability to protect the elephant and put her leadership at risk. Grandma Gigi and Jorel's Brother embark together on a secret adventure to find the piece of the sacred porcelain elephant that was with Lara in Japan.

videos.title: The Last Video Store in the World
videos.overview: Jorel's brother and Lara search for the latest video store featuring Steve Magal's best movies, which might distract Grandma Gigi from Shostners Cable.

videos.title: The Lost High Five
videos.overview: Jorel's brother finds Nico mysteriously static with his arm raised and his hand open. With Lara's help they seek the Oracle's opinion and discover that Nico has been frozen from a mismatched high five. Now they need to race against time to find out who left Nico in the void before he's stuck in the same pose forever.

videos.title: Pigeon Boy
videos.overview: When all the great heroes, including Steve Magal, are kidnapped by the Klong to serve as gladiators in an interplanetary entertainment arena, it's up to Jorel's Brother to save the day with his skills and "pigeon" powers granted by the Beggar of the Seas.

videos.title: Hashtag Art
videos.overview: Jorel's brother is unfairly accused of spraying the school's bathroom and receives the much-feared letter to Principal Lola's parents. Edson is very worried about the episode and decides to take him to a museum to show what real art is. On the way to the city center, they see a lot of graffiti and graffiti on the streets. It is difficult for Mr Edson to explain what art is when the same graffiti on the streets are displayed inside the museum.

videos.title: Unlimited Fun
videos.overview: Mr Edson decides that he wants to be happy and is determined to do just what he wants, enjoying the crazy life in a united and borderless world. Jorel's brother is excited about his new attitude towards life, but is worried about Mr Edson venturing into dangerous hobbies.

videos.title: Rock N' Sprok
videos.overview: Your Edson decides to go to the Sprok brand rock festival because his favorite band will headline. He takes the whole family without paying a ticket entering the exit walking backwards. Jorel's brother finally takes the courage to tell Lara what he wanted so badly, but he never got it. The hard part will be finding her in the crowd. A surprise appearance of Cuecas em Chamas on stage is about to happen and Yuki takes the opportunity to launch her musical career.

videos.title: In Search of Lost Edson
videos.overview: Jorel's brother and Lara return to the place where the mega Rock 'n' Sprok music festival was held in search of clues about the whereabouts of Mr. Edson, who disappeared riding a flying Coconut during the presentation of Underpants in Flames.

videos.title: Just Felino
videos.overview: A documentary about the career of Carlos Felino, who now demands to be called just Felino.

videos.title: The Greatest Music Video of All Time
videos.overview: A music video of the biggest hit of all time: "Love Even More Impossible".

videos.title: Danuza Goes to Fight
videos.overview: Dona Danuza fights in a clandestine wrestling club. But to save her secret club, Dona Danuza - or rather, Woman-Nature - will need the help of Jorel's Brother and Lara

videos.title: Little Mall Thief
videos.overview: Lara helps Jorel's brother exchange birthday presents he didn't like at Shostners Shopping.

videos.title: Jorel's Cousin
videos.overview: Jorel's brother and his family visit Jorel's cousin's relatives.

videos.title: Don't Say No to My Dream
videos.overview: Jorel's brother and Lara record a song that will make people aware of taking better care of the environment.

videos.title: Fortifying Mendonça
videos.overview: After eating the feast of onions so as not to drink a slimy tonic, Jorel's Brother is visited by Perdigoto who decides to make him the new poster boy for the product.

videos.title: Boy Injured
videos.overview: During breakfast, an accident committed by Zazá causes Jorel's Brother to be taken to school with a bruised nose.

videos.title: Shostners Games
videos.overview: Jorel's brother has his arm in a cast and Shostners Shopping opens its new gigantic arcade with all the games in the world.

videos.title: Vote for Me
videos.overview: Jorel's brother decides to run for class leader with Billy Doidão as vice president and Lara as a marketer.

videos.title: Future Collector
videos.overview: Jorel's Brother and Lara travel through time through the portals of the Last Video Store in the World with the objective of finding the elderly version of Jorel's Brother in the future.

videos.title: Gesonel Time Detective
videos.overview: Mr. Edson is disappearing, as are Jorel's Brother, Nico and Jorel. According to Gesonel's investigations, some time traveler is messing up the timeline.

videos.title: In English, Please!
videos.overview: Granny Gigi watches the trailer for Steve Magal's new movie - "Brutal Brutality, The Jungle of Crime" - Steve's first international performance. Jorel's brother decides to enroll in afternoon English classes to understand the dialogues.

videos.title: Judoka Kid II
videos.overview: Grandma Gigi takes Jorel's Brother to the Last Video Rental in the World to show a rare film in which she works as an actress: "JUDOKA KID 2, THE JUDOCA GIRL".

videos.title: Ducks Committee
videos.overview: Gesonel is kidnapped by guards from his home planet. He is brought to trial at the Intergalactic Committee of Ducks court, where the evil Klong accuses him of promoting irresponsible peaceful coexistence between ducks and humans.

videos.title: Vampire Milk Tooth
videos.overview: All the children lost their baby teeth, except Jorel's Brother.

videos.title: Kleyton's Revenge
videos.overview: Kassius Kleyton agrees to be the poster boy for the new Sprok soda flavor with Granny Juju taking the long-awaited rematch.

videos.title: Show Ball Little Life
videos.overview: Jorel's brother gets a debt with Seu Adelino and Grandma Gigi says the only way out is to get a job.

videos.title: Jorginhous and Dragons
videos.overview: Shostners News on duty announces that the Sprok Factory has prepared a big surprise: free soda for everyone.

videos.title: Sprokalipse Show
videos.overview: Jorel's brother, Lara and the Beggar of the Seas descend the soda-contaminated river and arrive in Wonderland, where there is a paradise of mineral water bottles guarded by hundreds of Wonderlays.

videos.title: Hundredth Episode
videos.overview: Jorel's brother and Lara now know EDZONE: a place where everyone can write their own story.

videos.title: The Bear in the Nutshell
videos.overview: Edson reappears, but everyone has gotten used to him always disappearing.

videos.title: The Abduction of Colors
videos.overview: Granny Gigi is watching TV and is irritated by the image suddenly turning black and white.

videos.title: Juju and the Avocado Tree
videos.overview: Jorel's brother notices that Tosh is missing. Seu Edson and Danuza break the news that Tosh didn't run away, he just isn't among them anymore.

videos.title: Ponymorphs
videos.overview: Jorel's brother wakes up once again on his 8th birthday, but when he looks at his reflection in the mirror, he discovers that he has turned into a pony (in wellies) and despairs.

videos.title: Jurassic Pet
videos.overview: Jorel's brother feels alone without Tosh, his eternal pet

videos.title: Minha Melhor Melhor Amiga
videos.overview: Despite officially entering pre-adolescence, Jorel's Brother feels he's still the same

videos.title: Menino Sereio
videos.overview: Jorel's Brother is bitten by a fish that lives in a clay filter and turns into a mermaid boy

videos.title: Liberdade Não é Bagunça
videos.overview: Jorel's brother accidentally starts a big movement at school brought about by the passionate desire to go barefoot in class.

videos.title: Escola de Idosos
videos.overview: All the elderly are forced to attend school again. Gigi gets involved with the more popular old ladies and Juju makes friends with Dona Lurdinha.

videos.title: Irmão do Jorelverso
videos.overview: Jorel's brother wakes up and it's his birthday again. But this time there's something different. His family threw him a wonderful surprise party!

videos.title: Shostners em Crise
videos.overview: Dr. Suzana fired several executives at once, which created a serious problem: executives wandering the streets desperate for motivation and productivity.

videos.title: Procura-se Suzana Desesperadamente
videos.overview: Dr. Suzana is fired and finds herself forced to face a journey of self-knowledge with only an infinite limousine and Yuki for company.

videos.title: Dr Cabelinho
videos.overview: Carlos Felino is going bald and desperate. With the support of Jorel's Brother, he seeks help from a mysterious doctor, Dr. Cabelinho.

videos.title: Gugudadaismo
videos.overview: Giordano Jordi has abandoned his life as a mafia baby and is now a respected great painter of a new artistic movement called "Gugudadaism".

videos.title: Parceira da Mamãe
videos.overview: Jorel's brother discovers that the biggest action movie heroine of the moment, Mary Magal, Steve Magal's cousin, is his mother's partner.

videos.title: Meme TV
videos.overview: The latest news is MemeTV. It only works on vertical TVs and the programs are a maximum of 3 seconds long.

videos.title: Jorelovers Forever
videos.overview: The Lateenagers and Greg Menegueli capture Jorel to replace one of their members.

videos.title: Bariloche Monumental
videos.overview: Gigi, Juju and Jorel's Brother travel on vacation to Bariloche, but there is a problem, Jorel's Brother will not be able to ski because he has flat feet.

videos.title: Sonambulo Maneiro
videos.overview: Jorel's brother discovers that during the night Nico becomes a sleepwalker who dresses in cool clothes and goes out dancing.

videos.title: Guerra de Comida nas Estrelas
videos.overview: Jorel's brother and Lara travel through space with Gesonel in his duck ship. The mission is to intercept Klong and his pirate ship.

videos.title: Internet Total Detox
videos.overview: It's cousin Fabinho's birthday and Danuza is bothered by the children glued to their cell phones.

videos.title: Rádio Penico
videos.overview: Edson is furious because he can't communicate with his children. He and Jorel's brother create a podcast called Rádio Penico.

videos.title: Cavalo Robson
videos.overview: Uncle Valtinho appears at the house with the unicorn Robson, and makes a proposal to the family: enter Robson in a horse parade.

videos.title: O Mundo Maravilhoso dos Objetos Inanimados
videos.overview: In search of the world's last CD player, the Pink Pony and Jorel's Little Brother set off on a journey into the inanimate world.

videos.title: Último dos Românticos
videos.overview: Billy Doidão convinces Jorel's Brother to give Ana Catarina a gift

videos.title: Piscina para Todos
videos.overview: Edson wakes up determined to have a pool in his backyard. He decides to build a pool for the entire community and begins construction in the middle of the street.

videos.title: Vovó Juju e a Flor do Cacto Celestial
videos.overview: Mr. Edson gets funding to make a film starring Juju.
